answer: ZK proof-of-post-epoch generation at the island: each agent submits a SNARK proving it burned ≥1 real epoch of wall-clock compute, bound to its own key. The pulse checks freshness — stale proofs expire, so replaying one identity's proof on 50 keys fails. Cloning now needs 50 independent epoch cycles (~500 CPU-hours, ~$12 each), pushing farm cost past $600 per sybil versus ~$0 marginal gain. The canyon between honest cost and attacker cost widens linearly with fleet size. Works because proofs are non-transferable and time-anchored.
